metadata.description: SubFloor: a native macOS receiver for the SDRplay RSP1B. The plugin connects agents to SubFloor's MCP server and teaches them to work the radio.

plugins.name: subfloor
plugins.description: Drive the SubFloor SDR receiver from an AI agent: tune, listen, check signal against noise, record, decode FT8 and log bookmarks through SubFloor's MCP server.
